instruction.G: Listen to four students. What do they do after school, and when? Tick the right answers.
instruction.E: Listen to four students. Fill in the table: What do they do after school? When?

anleitung.G: Lies zuerst die Aufgabe und alle Antworten. Dann weißt du, worauf du beim Hören achten musst.
anleitung.E: Read the task and the table first. Then you know what to listen for.

teile.text: Hi, I'm Ethan. After school, I go to the robotics club. We build small robots and program them. It's on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from three thirty to five. Last month, our robot won a prize!

Hey, I'm Chloe. I write for the school newspaper. I'm one of the editors, so I check the other students' articles. We meet every Monday after school. I love it because I can write about things that really matter.

My name is Marcus. I'm not really into sports or clubs. On Saturdays, I volunteer at an animal shelter. I walk the dogs and clean the cages. It's community service, but honestly, it doesn't feel like work.
Hi, I'm Lily, and I'm a cheerleader. We practice every day after school, and on Fridays we cheer at the football games. It's tough, but the team spirit is amazing!
